entities.summary: John Gorham Palfrey was an American clergyman and historian who served as a U.S. representative from Massachusetts. A Unitarian minister, he played a leading role in the early history of Harvard Divinity School, and he later became involved in politics as a State Representative and U.S. Congressman.
